lines.text: And wait till you hear what else counts as a berry.
To a botanist, a berry grows from one flower with a single ovary, and has seeds inside.
A banana fits. One ovary, seeds inside. Berry.
A strawberry grows from a flower with lots of ovaries. Every little dot on the outside is actually its own tiny fruit.
So what else is a true berry? Tomatoes. Grapes. Eggplants. Even watermelons and pumpkins.
